title: Senior Web Development Manager / Technical Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Ocean Multivision is a 360° branding and business transformation company that believes branding should not only be visible but also deliver measurable performance. The organization operates at the intersection of strategy, systems, and storytelling, helping businesses build structured, growth-driven ecosystems. Ocean Multivision focuses on aligning how a brand looks, communicates, and functions in real-world business environments. The company’s approach emphasizes scalability, conversion, and long-term business impact, making it an environment where technology and creativity work together to drive results.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Senior Web Development Manager / Technical Lead role is based in Noida. The role involves leading end-to-end web development initiatives, overseeing the design, development, and deployment of web applications and digital platforms. The individual will manage and mentor development teams, collaborate closely with design, marketing, and strategy stakeholders, and ensure technical solutions align with business goals and brand performance objectives. Responsibilities include defining technical architecture, setting coding standards, reviewing code quality, managing project timelines, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure solutions. The role also requires proactive problem-solving, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of web systems and processes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Front-End Development and Web Development, including modern frameworks and responsive design practices.
* Experience building and maintaining Web Applications, with a focus on performance, security, and scalability.
* Solid background in Software Development, including clean coding practices, version control, and debugging.
* Proven Project Management abilities to plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple initiatives on schedule.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and conducting architectural and code reviews.
* Familiarity with backend technologies, APIs, databases, and integration with third-party services.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in digital, branding, or agency environments is an advantage.

This is a senior technical leadership role, but not a hands-off advisory role: you will be expected to guide architecture, reduce technical debt, coach engineers and still personally produce deliverable engineering outcomes using modern tools, including approved AI coding assistants such as Claude, Codex and comparable enterprise-approved models. You will combine banking-domain depth, product architecture and hands-on engineering to turn complex banking, payments, regulatory and operational requirements into reusable, cloud-native capabilities incl. AI Use cases. The mandate is to build differentiated software that can scale across customers, markets and deployment models while enabling banks to modernise progressively.

**AI is part of the engineering method: use approved frontier and code-generation models such as Claude, Codex and comparable enterprise tools to accelerate architecture exploration, solution design, coding, testing and documentation. The expectation is not only to recommend direction, but to convert that direction into reviewed code, reference implementations, tests, migration patterns and working technical assets, while retaining human accountability, security controls and rigorous review.**

**Why This Role Matters**

Build a strategic growth platform. Digital Core sit at the centre of SBS's move towards AI native modular products, SaaS expansion and a more recurring, scalable software model. Your work will help protect trusted customer relationships while creating reusable capabilities for new growth.

**Engineer mission-critical banking.**
Shape the systems that manage accounts, deposits, product and pricing rules, real-time transactions and the full payment lifecycle, where availability, correctness, security and auditability are non-negotiable while providing AI capabilities to our customers

**Create reusable product value.**
Design capabilities once and make them reusable across markets, deployment models and SBS products, reducing duplication while accelerating customer outcomes.

**Turn the digital core into an intelligent core.**
Embed governed AI, real-time data and automation into core operations so banks can improve decisions, service and operational efficiency without sacrificing deterministic controls.

Influence a visible transformation. Work where product strategy, R&D focus, early-adopter delivery and engineering execution meet. Your architectural decisions will shape a flagship platform within SBS .

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architect distributed platforms.**
Design high-availability, cloud-native SaaS solutions using microservices, event-driven architecture and well-defined domain boundaries.

**Lead hands-on engineering.**
Write and review production code, reference implementations and reusable components for secure, resilient and maintainable services.

**Apply AI-assisted engineering.**
Use the latest approved AI models and coding assistants to produce and compare design options, draft architecture decision records, generate and refactor code, create tests, explain legacy code and improve technical documentation.

**Engineer responsibly with AI.**
Define prompts, context, evaluation criteria and review gates. Validate generated outputs for correctness, security, performance, licensing, privacy, bias and maintainability. Never expose confidential data to unapproved services.

**Convert architecture into deliverables.**
Personally produce hands-on outputs such as prototype services, reference implementations, proof points, migration utilities, test suites, performance experiments, code reviews and technical documentation that teams can adopt directly.

**Own banking-domain architecture.**
Translate the semantics and controls of deposits, account management, product and pricing, payment processing, into clear domain models, APIs, events and invariants

**Enable progressive modernisation.**
Design coexistence and migration patterns that allow banks to introduce modular capabilities, run new and legacy services side by side and move products and customers at a controlled pace.

**Own non-functional architecture.**
Drive performance, scalability, availability, observability, recoverability, maintainability and security from design through production.

**Shape cloud-native delivery.**
Leverage Kubernetes and AWS services; guide containerisation, deployment topology, configuration, secrets and release patterns.

**Embed quality and DevSecOps.**
Promote TDD, contract testing, automated quality controls, threat modelling and efficient CI/CD practices.

**Influence technical direction.**
Define and challenge application design strategies, standards, guardrails and effective development workflows.

**Collaborate and communicate.**
Work with product, business, security, architecture and engineering stakeholders, and present complex decisions clearly.

**Lead technical change management.**
Help teams adapt to AI-assisted engineering and modern delivery practices by setting examples, creating guardrails, running enablement sessions and building confidence in new ways of working.

**Build a strong technical bench.**
Raise the engineering bar through hiring input, interviewing, coaching, mentoring and succession planning, creating a team of strong technical people around the role rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

**Core Technical Skills**

**Backend engineering:**
Expert-level Java, including modern Java versions and strong Spring Boot experience; reactive programming and Spring WebFlux are advantageous.

**Architecture:**
Distributed systems, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture, microservices, APIs and SaaS product architecture.

**Data and messaging:**
SQL and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis; event streaming with Kafka.

**Cloud and platform:**
AWS, Kubernetes, Docker and Helm; GitLab CI and Argo CD experience is valuable.

**Quality engineering:**
JUnit, TDD, Spring Cloud Contract, automated integration and performance testing; K6 experience is advantageous.

**Front end and data processing:**
Working knowledge of TypeScript and Angular; Apache Spark exposure is beneficial.

**Security and compliance:**
Secure-by-design architecture, threat modelling, identity, data protection and financial-services regulatory expectations.

**AI engineering:**
Practical experience with enterprise-approved generative AI and coding assistants for architecture, code and test generation; ability to evaluate model outputs and design safe human-in-the-loop workflows.

**Hands-on delivery credibility:**
Proven record of remaining close to code and delivery while operating at senior architect level; comfortable producing tangible engineering assets rather than limiting contribution to strategy, reviews or governance.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:**
10+ years in software engineering within large product teams, including 5+ years of hands-on design responsibility for complex distributed solutions.

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Leadership:**
Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, influence decisions, resolve complex architectural challenges and communicate with senior stakeholders while staying close enough to implementation to unblock delivery and model excellent engineering practice.

**Domain:**
Experience in fintech, banking or payments, with an understanding of financial-sector security and compliance.

**AI fluency:**
Evidence of using modern AI models to improve architecture and engineering outcomes, combined with disciplined verification, secure data handling and measurable quality controls.

**Change agent:**
Experience helping engineering teams adopt new tools, AI-assisted workflows, modern development practices and higher standards through coaching, hands-on examples and pragmatic guardrails.

**Mindset:**
Curiosity, sound judgement, continuous learning and a track record of introducing valuable technology without compromising product quality.

**What Drives Our Teams**

We build mission-critical software with a long-term product mindset. Digital Core combines the scale and rigour of core banking with the pace of a modern software platform: modular architecture, API-first integration, real-time processing, cloud-native delivery, deep regulatory awareness and responsible AI. Architects are expected to contribute directly to code and design, simplify complexity, create reusable capabilities, coach others into stronger engineering habits and lead the change towards AI-enabled ways of working that improve customer outcomes across markets.

description:

**Location:**
[Noida/ Pan India] |
**Practice:**
MDM & Data Governance CoE |
**Experience:**
8+ years]
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an AI Architect to lead the design and evolution of AI-driven solutions within our Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Governance practice. This role sits at the intersection of data architecture and applied AI — designing intelligent accelerators (matching, stewardship automation, DCR resolution, data quality agents) that augment platforms like Reltio, Informatica IDMC, and Veeva Network, while also playing a key role in pre-sales and solution architecture for client pursuits.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Solution Architecture**

* Architect AI/ML and agentic solutions for core MDM and data governance use cases: match & merge, survivorship, DCR automation, anomaly detection, data quality scoring, and stewardship workflows
* Design and own the technical architecture for AI accelerators (e.g., Smart DCR Agents, Potential Match Resolution Agents, Agentic HCP/HCO Mastering engines), ensuring scalability, explainability, and platform-agnostic integration
* Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML techniques (LLMs, classical ML, rules + ML hybrid models) based on use case, data volume, and latency requirements
* Define reference architectures integrating AI layers with MDM platforms (Reltio, Informatica IDMC, Veeva Network) and governance/catalog tools (Collibra, Atlan, Alation)

**Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive performance tuning, accuracy benchmarking, and continuous optimization of existing AI accelerators and agents
* Establish feedback loops (human-in-the-loop stewardship, model retraining cadences) to improve match precision and reduce false positives/negatives over time
* Monitor and report on AI accelerator ROI metrics (cycle time reduction, automation rate, data quality lift) to clients and internal leadership
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy rule-based MDM/DG processes with AI-native alternatives

**Pre-Sales & Client Engagement**

* Lead AI/technical solutioning for RFP/RFI responses, including architecture diagrams, effort estimation, and differentiation narrative
* Partner with CoE and sales leadership to build and refine GTM assets (battlecards, demo environments, POV decks) for AI-powered MDM and governance offerings
* Present AI architecture and accelerator capabilities directly to client technical and business stakeholders, including live demos and technical deep-dives
* Support discovery workshops to assess client data maturity and identify high-value AI use cases within MDM/DG scope

**Delivery & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight during implementation, ensuring delivery teams correctly integrate AI components with MDM/DG platforms
* Collaborate with data engineering, MDM, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions align with data governance policies, security, and compliance requirements
* Mentor data scientists, engineers, and consultants on AI architecture best practices within the CoE
* Maintain reusable architecture patterns, technical documentation, and accelerator roadmaps for the CoE

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML architecture, data architecture, or related technical consulting roles
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying AI/ML or agentic solutions in production environments
* Strong working knowledge of MDM concepts (match/merge, survivorship, golden records) and data governance principles (stewardship, DCR workflows, policy management)
* Hands-on experience with at least one MDM platform (Reltio, Informatica IDMC, Veeva Network) and one governance/catalog tool (Collibra, Atlan, Alation)
* Proficiency in ML/LLM frameworks and cloud AI services (e.g., Python, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure/AWS AI services, LLM APIs)
* Experience contributing to RFP/RFI responses and client-facing technical presentations
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI architecture into business value for non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in life sciences/pharma data environments (HCP/HCO mastering, commercial data ecosystems)
* Prior experience building agentic AI systems or AI copilots for enterprise data workflows
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agent orchestration frameworks
* Relevant certifications in cloud AI/ML platforms or enterprise architecture

modern software architecture principles.

alignment with business and technical objectives.

● Architect scalable asynchronous workflows and inter-service communication using

messaging and event-streaming technologies.

● Define API standards, service contracts, and integration patterns to ensure interoperability

and maintainability across distributed systems.

● Ensure system scalability, fault tolerance, resilience, observability, performance, and

reliability through industry best practices.

● Evaluate and recommend architectural improvements, technology choices, and design

patterns to support long-term platform growth and engineering excellence.

**Full-Stack Development**

● Lead the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise-grade web applications using

Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript.

● Develop scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, and reusable frontend components

following industry best practices.

● Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.

● Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and DevOps teams to

deliver high-quality software solutions.

● Define and maintain API contracts, integration patterns, and coding standards to ensure

seamless communication between frontend and backend systems.

● Conduct code reviews, mentor developers, and promote engineering best practices across

the development team.

● Troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive continuous improvements in application

architecture, performance, and maintainability.

**Cloud & DevOps**

● Design, architect, and deploy scalable, secure, and highly available applications on AWS

using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, and

CloudWatch.

● Collaborate with DevOps teams to design cloud-native infrastructure, deployment strategies,

and production environments.

● Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, automated, and efficient

application deployments.

● Containerize applications using Docker and support orchestration using Kubernetes in

collaboration with platform engineering teams.

● Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives using tools such as Terraform or AWS

CloudFormation.

● Drive cloud security, cost optimization, scalability, and performance best practices across

AWS environments.

● Monitor application and infrastructure health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and

centralized logging solutions.

● Support production deployments, troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, and ensure high

availability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.

**Database & Performance**

● Design scalable data models using MongoDB and relational databases (MySQL or

PostgreSQL).

● Implement caching strategies using Redis.

● Optimize database performance, indexing, and query efficiency.

● Ensure application scalability and efficient resource utilization.

**Required Skills:**

● 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a Technical Lead,

Lead Engineer, or Senior Engineering role.

● Strong expertise in Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

● Proven experience designing and building scalable Microservices, RESTful APIs, and

distributed systems.

● Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and High-Level/Low-Level

Design (HLD/LLD).

● Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, cloud-native application development, and

scalable infrastructure.

● Experience with Docker, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; exposure to Kubernetes is

preferred.

● Strong knowledge of MongoDB and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.

● Experience with caching technologies such as Redis and performance optimization

techniques.

● Solid understanding of application security, API security, OWASP best practices, and secure

software development principles.

● Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as Kafka,

RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS.

● Proven experience conducting architecture reviews, code reviews, technical mentoring, and

engineering governance.

● Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

● Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams.

**Tech Stack:**

● Frontend: React.js, Next.js (Preferred), TypeScript, Redux

● Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, WebSockets

● Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, CloudWatch)

● Architecture: Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture

● Databases: MongoDB, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis

● DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes (Preferred), CI/CD, Terraform (Preferred)

● Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS

● Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch

**Good to Have:**

● Experience with AI/LLM integrations, RAG, or Generative AI applications.

● Exposure to DevSecOps and cloud security best practices.

● Experience in AR/VR, gaming, immersive technologies, or streaming platforms.

title: Tech S and T - Enterprise Application Architect-BAT -Senior Manager-GDS04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Application Architect - Senior Manager**
**The opportunity**
The Application Architect (Senior Manager) is responsible for building the detailed solution(s) for Applications in Cloud Transformation context. This role works under the guidance of the Account/Engagement Partner and the Enterprise Architect. This role works 50% on new opportunities shaping in existing or new client context and has 50% involvement in Delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with the end client, engagement partners, and enterprise architects to understand client business requirements, priorities, and the business case of the Technology Transformation.
* Work with consulting teams to incorporate domain/sector specific solutions. Have an AI first approach in solutioning & Architecting.
* Build Application Architecture by choosing the right technologies and platforms, including Integration, API Management layers & AI infusion.
* Work with the Competencies and Practices to arrive at suitable project approach, provide estimates and inputs to staffing plan.
* Work with the Delivery Governance team to analyse project delivery risks and mitigations.
* Delivery involvement as the “Solution Architect” to bring to life the conceived solution. Build the architecture, and project implementation/development/delivery framework

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in Technology Consulting and System Integration projects
* 5+ years’ experience in Cloud Transformation projects – involving Cloud Application Architecture, Cloud Native Application principles
* Experience in working & managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Hands-on experience in driving Application migrations to cloud including a combination of Lift & Shit, Re-platform, Re-factor or Re-architecture
* Hands-on experience in building Cloud Native Applications, APIs; knowledge of Application and Integration design patterns.
* Experience in Application Architecture & Design for Microservices in Cloud platforms
* Expertise in at least one Cloud Hyperscaler (AWS or Azure preferred);
* Deep work experience in atleast one API platform (Apigee, Mulesoft, Boomi etc)
* TOGAF certification will be a plus
* Experience in any of these sectors will be a plus - TMT (Telco, Media, Technology), Public Sector, Energy & Utilities and Travel & Leisure

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager Software Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead by example through active participation in software design, coding, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and implementation of complex features, ensuring engineering excellence and delivery quality across teams
* Lead and manage one or more agile engineering teams responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of business-critical applications
* Drive end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives, including AI/ML, digital modernization, client implementations, regulatory, compliance, and operational excellence programs
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Partners, Architects, Operations, and Client Teams to define roadmaps, prioritize work, and ensure successful execution of commitments
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for cloud-native, microservices-based applications while actively contributing to solution design, technical problem resolution, and critical engineering decisions to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability
* Establish engineering best practices, coding standards, quality gates, operational readiness processes, and software development governance across teams
* Manage application lifecycle activities including solution design, development, testing, deployment, production support, performance optimization, and continuous improvement
* Drive adoption of AI-powered engineering practices, automation, developer productivity tools, and data-driven decision-making to improve delivery efficiency and quality
* Lead, mentor, coach, and develop engineering talent; support performance management, career growth, succession planning, hiring, and organizational capability development
* Partner with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate technical, operational, delivery, compliance, security, and business risks
* Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, AI governance, and software development best practices
* Oversee vendor and contractor engagements, resource planning, budget management, capacity forecasting, delivery governance, and operational effectiveness
* Communicate effectively with senior leadership, business stakeholders, product teams, and client partners regarding delivery status, risks, dependencies, funding, and strategic priorities
* Lead Scrum ceremonies, release planning, architecture reviews, code quality reviews, production readiness reviews, incident management, root cause analysis, and operational governance activities
* Drive engineering excellence through effective use of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, monitoring, and DevOps best practices
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and technical excellence while maintaining a solid focus on business outcomes and customer value
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* B. Tech / MCA or equivalent degree (Minimum 16 years of formal education)
* 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3-5 years of engineering leadership and people management experience
* Proven experience leading multiple agile teams delivering large-scale enterprise applications and strategic technology initiatives
* Hands-on experience with Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful APIs, Kafka, Kubernetes/Nomad, Azure Cloud Services, AI, Git, Splunk, and databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL
* Demonstrated experience driving cloud modernization, DevOps adoption, CI/CD implementation, operational excellence, and engineering transformation initiatives
* Experience delivering AI/ML-enabled solutions, automation initiatives, and modern engineering practices within enterprise environments
* Experience managing production support, incident response, risk management, release governance, and service reliability objectives
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, and modern software delivery methodologies
* Solid background in Full Stack Engineering and microservices architecture with expertise in enterprise application development
* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, security, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization
* Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across Product, Operations, Business, Client, Compliance, and Technology organizations
* Proven solid analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills
* Proven excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence outcomes across teams and leadership levels
* Proven ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, or Intelligent Automation initiatives
* Experience in Healthcare, Utilization Management, or other regulated domains
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams and vendor partners
* Knowledge of enterprise governance, compliance, security, and AI risk management frameworks

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are
*disproportionately*
experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

The Opportunity
  
  
Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe’s strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized, connected customer experiences at scale.

This position will also offer technical and personnel leadership for essential product development, guaranteeing the delivery of scalable, dependable, and high-quality customer solutions.
  
  
The Challenge
  
  
As an Engineering Manager, you will direct technical implementation, support people development, and advance strategic engineering initiatives. Key areas of responsibility include:
  
  

* Security Leadership: Own and drive Adobe Campaign’s security strategy in an evolving threat landscape developed by frontier AI models and increasingly sophisticated attack techniques. Partner with Security and Engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and strengthen the product’s security posture. Help advance Adobe’s security practices and capabilities to address emerging AI-related risks while ensuring the continued protection of customer data and enterprise systems.
* Technical Leadership: Guide architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems.
* People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing team.
* Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices.
* Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other collaborators to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.
* Own and complete the security charter for Adobe Campaign, including security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and collaboration with internal security organizations.
* Provide technical direction and oversight across the team’s engineering initiatives.
* Deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through sound engineering methods and technical decision-making.
* Direct application security and vulnerability oversight for enterprise SaaS products, involving threat modeling, secure code review, source/sink/escape analysis, and addressing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
* Address security vulnerabilities across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, SOAP, and REST surfaces, including injection, broken authentication and authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and complex pre-authentication RCE chains.
* Partner with teams across multiple functions to define priorities, manage execution, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Identify and address technical, operational, and architectural challenges.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices.
* Participate in hiring, performance management, and career development.
* Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced Agile environment.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, architectural patterns, and modern frameworks.
* Strong computer science fundamentals and system build experience.
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure and modern engineering tools and practices.
* Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages.
* Experience building scalable, reliable enterprise software.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software development lifecycles, with the ability to boost developer efficiency, code quality, and security review efficiency.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in application security, secure software development, vulnerability management, or security engineering.
* Experience driving security initiatives for enterprise software products.
* Experience with security scanning, CVE remediation, threat modeling, authentication and authorization, and security compliance.
* Experience working with extensive enterprise SaaS solutions.

**Good to Have**
**Application security & vulnerability management for enterprise SaaS:**
Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

title: AIML Technology Architect
description:
**The Role**

As an AI/ML Technology Architect, you will lead the end-to-end design of agentic AI systems for the platform. You will own the architecture of multi-agent workflows, the orchestration backbone, agent communication patterns, evaluation frameworks, safety guardrails, and reusable design patterns that the engineering team will build against.

This is a hands-on architect role, not a purely advisory or documentation-led role. The expectation is that you can design, review, prototype, debug, and guide implementation of production-grade agentic AI systems. You will work closely with founders, product leaders, engineers, and customer-facing teams to translate enterprise problems into scalable AI agent capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architect production-grade multi-agent AI systems**
  using
  **LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI**
  , or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Design stateful agent workflows
* Define agent capabilities for data discovery, profiling, scoring, enrichment, intelligence extraction, and contextual reasoning across enterprise data estate.
* Build and guide the
  **design of structured data agents**
  that can introspect live databases, infer schema meaning and generate ER-level understanding.
* Design document
  **intelligence pipelines for large-scale extraction from unstructured data**
  like PDFs, Word documents, emails, call transcripts, and semi-structured enterprise content using tools such as Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, LlamaParse, or equivalent technologies.
* Architect vector database and retrieval pipelines, including
  **chunking strategies, embedding model selection,**
  metadata design, hybrid search, retrieval tuning, and domain-specific
  **RAG patterns.**
* Define agent evaluation methodology covering
  **accuracy, precision, recall, recall@k, regression testing, drift detection, hallucination checks, and robustness testing**
  for non-deterministic AI outputs.
* Establish
  **AI safety and trust patterns, including semantic guardrails, jailbreak protection, prompt injection**
  , data exfiltration prevention, toxic output mitigation, policy-based response control, and secure tool-use design.
* Architect agent communication and message queuing patterns
  **using RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms**
  for scalable and resilient agent-to-agent/task communication.
* Lead technical reviews, mentor AI/ML engineers, validate architecture decisions, and own the technical quality of agent releases.
* Define reference implementations, reusable templates, coding patterns, and engineering standards for building agentic AI capabilities consistently across the platform.
* Partner with founders and product teams to translate business problems into clear agent specifications, platform capabilities, and implementation roadmaps.
* Optimize LLM cost and latency through prompt caching, batching, token budgeting, model routing, model selection, and efficient prompt/context design.
* Stay current with the agentic AI and LLM ecosystem, including Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models,
  **LangChain/LangGraph**
  , emerging evaluation tools, and enterprise AI deployment patterns.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or applied AI/ML systems, with at least 4–5 years in AI/ML or applied ML solution development.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production, not limited to notebooks, PoCs, or isolated demos.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-agent orchestration in production, using frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain**
  , or equivalent technologies.
* Proven experience building SQL or structured data agents that can connect to live databases, inspect schemas, infer semantic meaning, and generate relationship-level understanding.
* Strong working knowledge of
  **RAG, vector databases, embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation**
  . Deep knowledge of Pinecone, Milvus, or Qdrant, specifically around hybrid search (sparse + dense), reranking models (Cohere/BGE), and dynamic chunking strategies.
* Experience deploying open-source models (Llama, Gemma) via
  **vLLM or Ollama**
  to optimize throughput and cost.
* Experience implementing evaluation frameworks using tools such as
  **RAGAS, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval,**
  custom evaluation pipelines, or equivalent approaches.
* **Strong Python skills**
  and familiarity with the modern AI/ML engineering stack; ability to read, review, debug, and guide implementation-level code

**Good to Have**

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic data models, or enterprise metadata models.
* Open-source contributions in the AI/ML, data engineering, or agentic AI ecosystem.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, observability, and production AI governance.
* Exposure to custom model training, fine-tuning, or domain adaptation, though the platform will primarily build on API-based and open-source LLMs.

**Why This Role Is Exciting**

You will be one of the most senior technical voices in the founding team. You will be defining the platform architecture, engineering patterns, AI safety controls, and agentic design principles from the ground up.

The work will be hands-on, the autonomy will be high, and the impact will be highly visible. This role offers the opportunity to shape a venture-backed Infosys platform, influence early customer success, mentor the founding engineering team, and build enterprise-grade AI systems that can operate at real-world scale.

title: Head of Engineering (Technical Leadership)
description:
**About IndiaMART:**

IndiaMART is an online B2B marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers. Our mission is to make doing business easy. We are investing in the technology, platforms and engineering capabilities that help businesses discover, connect and grow.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build an AI-native engineering organisation at IndiaMART. You will shape technical direction and make AI an integral part of how teams design, build, test and operate software, while strengthening the platforms and production systems our business depends on.

This role combines current, personal AI practice with broad systems judgment and the ability to lead people and change. You will work across product engineering, data, infrastructure and security, build the AI infrastructure and developer tools teams need, and turn new capabilities into dependable engineering outcomes.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Build an AI-native engineering organisation**
  . Shape how teams design, build, test and operate software using AI. Establish shared platforms, developer tools and reusable patterns that help teams turn ideas into reliable products faster, and measure success through adoption, quality and business impact.
* **Build the AI foundations teams need**
  . Establish model and data access, developer tools, evaluation, observability, permissions and cost controls. Help teams adopt effective workflows and improve them as model capabilities evolve.
* **Lead technology and engineering**
  . Set technical direction and priorities, own delivery, develop managers and senior engineers, and build a culture of sound engineering judgment and accountability.
* **Build capabilities teams want to use**
  . Create practical, reusable paths for APIs, frontends, data, testing, deployment and operations. Treat shared services as internal products, with clear interfaces, support and migration plans.
* **Improve the existing estate**
  . Connect decisions across applications, databases, messaging, cloud and security. Simplify or retire systems in stages, informed by reliability, customer outcomes and operating cost.
* **Make safe delivery routine**
  . Embed security, testing, observability and recovery into everyday work. Reduce repeated manual intervention and approvals through effective controls and clear accountability.

**What you should bring:**

* **Bring practical experience building with AI and strong engineering judgment**
  . You understand how models, agents, data and conventional software fit together, can evaluate their limitations, and can guide teams from promising prototypes to dependable production systems.
* **Personal technical depth**
  : consequential software or platforms you helped build, with decisions, mistakes and results you can explain in detail.
* **Technical breadth**
  : judgment across applications and frontends, APIs, data, infrastructure, reliability, security and AI. You understand how choices interact and when to involve specialists.
* **Delivery ownership**
  : a record of delivering engineering outcomes across teams, resolving obstacles and staying accountable through adoption, maintenance and later consequences.
* **People leadership**
  : experience leading through managers, developing technical leaders and owning organisation outcomes, with the judgment to integrate specialist teams and operate at substantial scale.
* **Clear communication and influence**
  : explain choices to technical, product and business audiences, work through disagreement and secure adoption across reporting lines.

**Relevant experience:**

Experience building shared platforms, scaling software products or improving complex production systems is particularly relevant. We welcome technical founders, early engineering leaders and operators from established companies who bring sustained ownership and measurable engineering impact.

**What success looks like:**

AI-native workflows and shared capabilities that teams adopt; faster delivery with better quality; less repeated work and manual intervention; reliable, secure systems; and stronger technical leaders. Establish baselines and demonstrate improvements in delivery effort, reliability and operating cost.

**Reporting to**
: Chief Product Officer

**Location:**
Noida Sector 135

* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

**✅ Required Skills**
**C/C++ on macOS & Windows**
8+ years of system-level development on macOS
  
  
**IOKit & Core Foundation**
USB enumeration, device matching, CF types
  
  
**CryptoTokenKit (CTK)**
Token extension development — macOS Ventura/Sonoma+
  
  
**Security.framework & POSIX IPC**
Cryptographic APIs, UNIX domain sockets, launchd
  
  
**Code Signing & Notarization**
Hardened Runtime, entitlements, codesign, productsign, spctl
  
  
**Xcode & Build Tooling**
xcodebuild, Makefiles, packagesbuild, hdiutil
  
  
**PKCS#11 / Smart Card Standards**
PIV, ISO 7816, cryptographic token integration
  
  
**CI/CD Pipelines**
GitLab CI or equivalent for macOS automation
  
  
**Cryptography & PQC**
RSA, ECC, AES, ECDH; NIST PQC standards: ML-KEM, ML-DSA
  
  
**Thought leadership and communication**
Drive innovation and creative solution, strong and effective communication skills

Expertise in using AI coding agents and LLM tools like Claude Code, Gemini, Cline daily to accelerate development, code review, documentation, and root-cause analysis & can craft effective prompts for code review, security analysis, documentation generation, and commit message / changelog automation.

title: System Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The System Architect, based in Noida, will define the technical vision and target architecture for secure, scalable IAM platforms and AI-native engineering capabilities. The role combines deep systems architecture expertise with hands-on leadership in agentic AI, AI coding agents, and modern software delivery.
  
  
The architect will design identity capabilities for workforce, customer, partner, machine, workload, and AI-agent identities, covering authentication, authorization, governance, adaptive access, threat detection, and secure delegation.
  
  
The role will lead AI-native practices across architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, and operations. The successful candidate must use and govern AI coding agents in real engineering workflows and design agentic systems with bounded autonomy, traceability, and enterprise-grade quality, security, privacy, and compliance.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Key Areas Of Responsibility**

* Own the target architecture and roadmap for IAM and AI-enabled platforms, aligned with business strategy, Zero Trust, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
* Architect identity, lifecycle, credential, authorization, delegation, governance, audit, and threat-detection capabilities for human and non-human identities.
* Design agentic AI systems that plan, use tools, collaborate, and execute multi-step workflows within defined security and operational boundaries.
* Define guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, human approval, tool access, runtime isolation, context, observability, auditability, and safe failure.
* Lead AI-native engineering across requirements, architecture, coding, testing, reviews, documentation, deployment, and operations.
* Use AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and delivery automation.
* Govern AI-assisted development through approved-tool controls, data protection, output validation, secure review, provenance, and traceability.
* Translate business outcomes into reference architectures, decision records, quality attributes, service objectives, and implementation guardrails.
* Architect resilient cloud-native, distributed, event-driven, and API-first systems with strong production readiness and cost efficiency.
* Lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, technical discovery, proofs of concept, build-versus-buy analysis, and cross-functional decisions.
* Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, compliance, and legal teams to deliver secure, auditable, resilient solutions.
* Mentor architects and engineers and produce clear, reusable architecture guidance, threat models, diagrams, evaluations, and runbooks.

**Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language**

* 12+ years designing and delivering complex software platforms, with substantial architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional delivery responsibility.
* 7+ years in IAM across customer or workforce identity, federation, SSO, MFA, password less access, lifecycle governance, privileged access, and fine-grained authorization.
* Minimum requirement: hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI solutions using planning, tool invocation, retrieval, context or memory, multi-step workflows and human or policy controls.
* Minimum requirement: hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, reviews, documentation, or delivery automation.
* Experience governing AI-generated code through human review, automated testing, security scanning, secrets and dependency checks, provenance, and auditability.
* Strong generative AI knowledge covering models, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, model and tool selection, evaluation, observability, cost, and responsible AI.
* Practical understanding of agent risks, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, data leakage, identity spoofing, supply-chain compromise, and unsafe actions.
* Strong experience with cloud-native, distributed, multi-tenant systems, APIs, asynchronous messaging, containers, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, and observability.
* Deep IAM knowledge, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, PKI, workload identity, secrets, and policy-based authorization.
* Strong system-design fundamentals across domain and API design, resilience, consistency, scalability, performance, security, privacy, data architecture, and operations.
* Hands-on capability across modern programming ecosystems, quality engineering, threat modeling, technical specifications, architecture decisions, and reference implementations.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders, lead technical decisions, mentor engineers, and align product, engineering, security, and operations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting identity, authorization, delegation, and governance for AI agents and other non-human identities.
* Experience with secure agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent integration, including Model Context Protocol or equivalent approaches.
* Experience with specification-driven development, reusable AI workflows, and organization-wide AI-assisted engineering adoption.
* Experience evaluating, red-teaming, monitoring, and responding to incidents involving generative or agentic AI systems.
* Experience with AI-enabled identity or security capabilities, including adaptive access, behavioral analytics, threat detection, fraud, risk scoring, or identity proofing.
* Experience designing model-agnostic AI platforms, enterprise knowledge integration, reusable agents, and cost-aware model routing.
* Experience with software and AI supply-chain security, regulated platforms, or contributions to architecture communities, standards, publications, or open source.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Role: Director of Engineering**

**Location: Bengaluru and Noida**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Company:**

At PhysicsWallah (PW), we are on a mission to democratize education at scale in India. What started as a vision by our founder Alakh Pandey to provide high-quality, affordable education to every student has now grown into India's leading EdTech unicorn. We serve millions of students across online, offline, and hybrid modes, reaching 98% of India’s pin codes.

We don't just build software; we build platforms that shape futures. Our technology team tackles massive scale—supporting huge concurrent user bases, streaming live classes seamlessly, and integrating AI to create personalized, interactive learning experiences. If you are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technologies across frontend, backend, cloud, and AI to make a tangible impact on the next generation, PW is the place for you.

**Responsibilities:**

As an Engineering Director, you will act as a pivotal technical leader, driving the architecture and execution of full-stack platforms that serve millions of daily active users.

* **Architectural Leadership:**
  Drive the technical vision, system architecture, and technology stack choices across frontend and backend to ensure our platforms are highly scalable, secure, performant, and resilient.
* **Full-Stack Engineering:**
  Lead the development of robust backend services and scalable, high-performance frontend applications using technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Golang, React.js, and Next.js.
* **Team Building & Mentorship:**
  Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and Software Development Engineers. Foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
* **Strategic Execution:**
  Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to align engineering deliverables with the company’s product roadmap and business goals.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  Establish and enforce best practices in software development, CI/CD, automation, code reviews, testing, and system monitoring.
* **Innovation & AI Integration:**
  Spearhead the adoption of modern technologies, including AI/ML frameworks, to personalize student learning and optimize internal operations.
* **Resource Management:**
  Manage budgets, infrastructure costs, and engineering bandwidth effectively, honoring our core value of operational frugality without compromising on quality.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, Associate Director or Senior Engineering Manager).
* **Full-Stack Technical Expertise:**
  Strong experience across frontend and backend engineering, with expertise in technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Golang, React.js, and Next.js.
* **Backend & Distributed Systems:**
  Deep understanding of system design, distributed systems, microservices, API design, and event-driven architectures.
* **Frontend Architecture:**
  Experience designing and scaling modern frontend applications, with strong understanding of performance optimization, frontend architecture, and user experience.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* **Database Mastery:**
  Extensive knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL), caching mechanisms (Redis), and data sharding at scale.
* **B2C Scale Experience:**
  Proven track record of building and scaling high-traffic consumer tech products with massive Daily Active Users (DAU) and Monthly Active Users (MAU).
* **Agile Methodology:**
  Strong command over agile software development practices and a history of leading successful sprints and timely product launches.

**What You Will Need**

* **A Student-First Mindset:**
  A deep, genuine passion for education and an empathetic understanding of the challenges faced by students across the country.
* **Problem-Solving DNA:**
  The ability to break down complex, ambiguous technical problems into actionable, elegant solutions.
* **Exceptional Communication:**
  The clarity to translate highly technical concepts into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, and the ability to articulate business goals to engineering teams.
* **Resilience & Agility:**
  The energy to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can shift to meet market demands.
* **Frugal Innovation:**
  The mindset to build smart, cost-effective technology solutions that allow us to keep our courses highly affordable for the masses.
