title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Product Modernization - ACC+AJO Migration - Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We seek Senior Consultants and Architects with deep, hands-on expertise in Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC), Adobe Campaign Standard (ACS), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) to help enterprise customers modernize campaign and customer-journey programs. The role leads discovery, current-state assessment, target-state architecture, implementation, integration, testing, coexistence, cutover, and enablement. You will understand how customers use ACC or ACS today, identify use cases suited to AJO, and redesign them for AEP and AJO. Some functionality must be rebuilt, redesigned, retained, or handled through an integration or alternative solution. Candidates must explain product boundaries, assess feature and use-case fit, surface gaps early, and set realistic customer expectations. In AJO, a migrated use case lands on AJO Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven orchestration on AEP Real-Time Customer Profile) or AJO Orchestrated Campaigns (campaign-centric, batch, multi-step workflows on the AEP relational data store). Candidates must design and build on both, and recommend the right path per use case.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
- Assess and plan
- Lead discovery workshops with marketing, campaign operations, data, architecture, security, mobile, and IT stakeholders.
- Inventory the Campaign estate: use cases (batch, scheduled, transactional, event-triggered, real-time); assets (campaigns, workflows, audiences, deliveries, templates, content blocks, personalization, typologies, suppression rules, reporting); data (schemas and extensions, custom resources, relational data, targeting dimensions, identifiers, consent, opt-out, quarantine, bounce, engagement history); and infrastructure (on-premises or Managed Services hosting, network access, firewalls, file transfer, decommissioning needs).
- Reverse-engineer custom logic and document the business rules: technical and marketing workflows (query, enrichment, split, deduplication, reconciliation, update data, JavaScript code activities), custom JavaScript, JSSP, SOAP/JS API calls, SQL functions, stored procedures, custom relational structures, typology rules, input forms, web applications, landing pages, subscriptions, Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, offer logic, external accounts, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations.
- Map each use case and dependency to an AJO/AEP target pattern and classify it as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain elsewhere. For custom logic, decide whether to re-express it in AEP/AJO (data model, Query Service, custom actions, external services), redesign or rebuild it separately, or retain it in Campaign.
- Choose the execution path per use case based on the target customer experience, not the shape of the source Campaign workflow. Use AJO Journeys when each profile should progress individually based on behaviour, events, or elapsed time, including many scheduled and recurring Campaign workflows rebuilt as Read Audience or business-event journeys. Use Orchestrated Campaigns for relational or multi-entity data, complex audience construction and enrichment, exact pre-send counts, and multi-level sending. Use action campaigns for simple scheduled or API-triggered sends. Document the rationale, combined patterns, and license prerequisites (e.g., the Journey Optimizer Campaigns package).
- Surface product-fit gaps and operational impacts before committing to scope or feature-parity claims. Advise when Campaign coexistence or another path fits better: Campaign v8 for ACC customers, or the ACS-to-Campaign v8 transition for ACS customers.
- Develop phased roadmaps, effort estimates, dependency plans, risks, and customer decision points.
- Architect and implement
- Design the AEP foundation: XDM schemas and field groups (profile, event, lookup); identity namespaces, identity resolution, profile enablement, and data relationships; datasets, sources, destinations, batch and streaming ingestion, and event design; data quality and governance; audience qualification and segmentation; and Query Service or other processing for transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.
- Replace common Campaign data patterns with AEP capabilities: Federated Audience Composition on Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or other warehouses (closest to ACC Federated Data Access); computed attributes for profile-level aggregates; Data Distiller for scheduled SQL transformations; merge policies; and profile and segmentation guardrails.
- Design customer experiences and build AJO journeys and campaigns across batch and event-driven engagement: event- and segment-triggered orchestration, conditions, actions, custom actions, message content, personalization, and decisioning.
- Apply journey and campaign governance and optimization: business rules, frequency capping, quiet hours, journey priority and arbitration, conflict management, wave sending, content experimentation, and decisioning policies and rankings.
- Define security, access, permissions, governance, and operational controls.
- Build channels, integrations, and extensibility
- Configure AJO channels end to end: email, mobile and web push, in-app, web, code-based experiences, content cards, inbox, live activities, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, and direct mail. Cover channel configurations, subdomains, API credentials, feedback webhooks, mobile app and SDK dependencies, channel-specific data and consent requirements, and template approval rules (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta).
- Connect messaging providers: native SMS providers (Sinch, Twilio, Infobip); bring-your-own-provider (BYOP) setups with provider payloads, inbound keyword handling, delivery receipts, and opt-in/opt-out webhooks and flows; and Channel Builder custom channels for non-native platforms or customer-owned gateways (e.g., regional or industry-specific providers), covering endpoint, authentication, throttling, payload structure, and monitoring.
- Design and build integrations using supported APIs, source connectors, file exchange, middleware, or Adobe solution integrations, including custom actions that call external systems from journeys (CRM, loyalty, order, recommendation, call-center, notification services) with request/response schemas, authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS), capping, throttling, retries, and error handling.
- Implement event and API-triggered patterns: unitary and business events, API-triggered and transactional campaigns, Interactive Message Execution / Journey and Campaign APIs, and streaming ingestion via HTTP API.
- Design and build Journeys (profile-centric)
- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization

**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Athenian Tech is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to take hands-on ownership of core areas of our AI-driven threat intelligence platform. This live, production platform ingests threat data from a wide range of external sources, enriches and scores it, and delivers curated intelligence feeds to enterprise customers over industry standard protocols. You will work closely with senior technology leadership to own production stability and data quality while helping shape architecture and process as the platform scales.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own deep hands-on platform architecture, data pipeline, enrichment, scoring and delivery.
* Ensure production reliability across production, UAT and local environments, owning monitoring, alerting, healthchecks, and acting as the escalation point for incidents.
* Maintain daily data quality of the intelligence feed including data provenance, scoring integrity, and false positive control.
* Enforce strict change management discipline including testing, rollback plans, and verification of every change.
* Evaluate and onboard new data sources into the platform (feed lifecycle management).
* Handle technical aspects of customer onboarding including access scoping, feed configuration, and integration support with enterprise SIEM and SOAR platforms.
* Keep runbooks and documentation current, and assist in interviewing and building the engineering team.
* Drive the engineering backlog, delivery cadence, and production readiness work.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline with strong fundamentals in operating systems, networking, and data structures.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in backend, platform, or security engineering with hands-on responsibility for a production system.
* Strong proficiency in Python as the primary language for platform and automation work.
* Strong Linux command-line skills including managing services, cron, logs, and troubleshooting production servers.
* Hands-on database experience at production scale, ideally Elasticsearch, along with SQL basics; Redis or RabbitMQ exposure is a plus.
* Strong AWS experience with EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, and running self-hosted workloads with Docker.
* Strong reasoning and debugging ability, with clear written communication skills for runbooks and customer documentation.
* A dynamic, ownership-driven working style suited to a fast-paced startup environment.

**Preferred Skills & Nice To Have**

* Exposure to cyber security, threat intelligence, or SOC workflows including IOC lifecycle, STIX, TAXII, MISP, VirusTotal, Shodan.
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms such as OpenCTI, or integrating with enterprise SIEM and SOAR products.
* GraphQL API experience and nginx configuration knowledge.
* Prior mentoring experience or aspiration to grow into a lead role.
* AWS, Red Hat, Elastic, or security certifications (Security+, CEH) are a bonus.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Real ownership on a live product with paying enterprise customers.
* Fast-paced startup environment with a strong engineering and intelligence culture and short decision paths.
* Competitive salary based on experience with clear growth path to a lead role as the team scales.
* Work from the Noida office with a six-day support cadence including alternate Saturdays.

Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.

**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

The primary focus will be helping our clients solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)

* Lead and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.
* Architect, implement, deploy, and support analytical databases and pipelines in an Azure environment

* Create and deploy accurate client architecture and analyses in a relatively short period of time.

* Proven track record in managing complex data projects and leading cross-functional teams.
* Experience in working with large datasets, data warehousing, and advanced analytics tools.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise data warehouse and data lake implementations
* 5+ years of external client consulting experience
* 5+ years of hands-on experience building automated ETL/ELT or data integration processes utilizing multiple source systems
* 5+ years of team management experience (including offshore resources)
* 5+ years of experience leading multiple external client projects simultaneously
* 5+ years of preparing detailed external client project budget estimations with strong resource management capabilities
* 3+ years of in-depth experience in architecting, designing, and implementing complex data architectures on Azure including Azure Data Factory, Azure/Managed Instance SQL Server, Azure Logic App, and Azure Synapse Analytics
* Experience mentoring teammates or conducting technical training
* Possess integrity and a strong work ethic
* Strong analytical and verbal/written communication skills

+ Requirements gathering
+ Infrastructure planning and deployment
+ Subject matter expert interviews

+ ETL/ELT development and maintenance model and data validation

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with 12+ years of Salesforce experience to own the overall Salesforce solution architecture and technical direction for an enterprise client. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, high-performing Salesforce solutions aligned with business objectives while providing technical leadership to development, integration, and delivery teams.

The ideal candidate will combine hands-on Salesforce development expertise with enterprise architecture, solution design, and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, enterprise integrations, Salesforce AI capabilities, and large-scale implementations is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Salesforce Solution Architecture

* Own the overall Salesforce solution architecture, ensuring scalability, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements.
* Lead solution design and architecture for complex Salesforce implementations, enhancements, integrations, and transformation initiatives.
* Make architectural decisions related to Salesforce data models, integrations, security, automation, custom development, APIs, and platform capabilities.
* Identify technical risks, scalability concerns, architectural gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure architecture decisions follow Salesforce best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

2. Salesforce Development & Technical Leadership

* Maintain hands-on involvement in Salesforce development using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flows, Salesforce APIs, and integrations.
* Provide technical direction to developers, technical leads, integration teams, and Salesforce professionals.
* Review technical designs, code, integrations, and implementation approaches.
* Guide teams in developing scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-performing Salesforce solutions.
* Resolve complex technical challenges and recommend appropriate architectural solutions.

3. Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture

* Design and oversee integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications, middleware, external systems, and third-party platforms.
* Define integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware, and other enterprise integration patterns.
* Establish appropriate data architecture, data flows, synchronization mechanisms, and integration standards.
* Ensure secure and reliable data exchange across enterprise applications.
* Address Salesforce governor limits, data volumes, performance bottlenecks, and integration scalability.

4. Salesforce Platform & Cloud Solutions

* Lead solution design across Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
* Evaluate and apply Revenue Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud where relevant to business requirements.
* Drive adoption of modern Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein AI, and other emerging Salesforce technologies.
* Assess platform capabilities and recommend appropriate standard, declarative, or custom development approaches.
* Ensure solutions leverage Salesforce capabilities effectively while minimizing unnecessary complexity.

title: Senior Solution Architect – SAS, Informatica IDMC & Snowflake
description:
We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect with extensive hands-on technical expertise in SAS, SQL, Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps. The ideal candidate must be a hardcore technical architect with a strong development background who can analyze complex data processing solutions, design target-state architectures, and guide implementation across the enterprise data engineering lifecycle.

The role involves assessing SAS-based workloads, defining migration and integration strategies, translating legacy processing logic into modern ETL/ELT architectures, and designing scalable solutions using Informatica IDMC and Snowflake. The candidate must be equally comfortable with architecture design, code-level analysis, development guidance, performance optimization, and troubleshooting. Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks experience is desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and guide end-to-end data integration architectures using SAS, Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, SQL, and related enterprise data technologies.
* Perform hands-on analysis of SAS programs, SAS DI jobs, DATA Step logic, PROC SQL, macros, transformations, scheduling, and dependencies.
* Evaluate workloads for migration, consolidation, optimization, or retirement based on business and technical requirements.
* Translate SAS processing logic into Informatica IDMC mappings, transformations, taskflows, and Snowflake-based SQL processing.
* Address functional differences between SAS and target platforms, including data types, null handling, sorting, joins, date processing, aggregations, and numeric precision.
* Define scalable ETL/ELT architecture patterns for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, validation, exception handling, and downstream delivery.
* Establish Informatica IDMC design standards for Cloud Data Integration, mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, reusable components, parameterization, Secure Agents, and error recovery.
* Design Snowflake solutions covering data modeling, SQL transformations, stored procedures, incremental processing, pushdown optimization, and performance tuning.
* Develop or review complex SAS programs, SQL queries, stored procedures, and integration logic to validate architecture decisions and resolve implementation challenges.
* Define source-to-target mappings, data models, data contracts, lineage requirements, data quality standards, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Establish engineering standards for Azure DevOps, Git, branching, code reviews, CI/CD, automated testing, and controlled deployments.
* Define environment promotion, configuration management, deployment validation, rollback, monitoring, logging, and operational recovery approaches.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, proof-of-concept development, and performance evaluations.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across SAS, Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, SQL, and associated data integration components.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership, mentor developers, challenge inefficient designs, and establish reusable engineering patterns.
* Ensure architecture addresses security, access control, auditability, scalability, maintainability, and operational support requirements.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
* Define technical acceptance criteria, production readiness standards, and implementation guidelines for reliable enterprise data solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, enterprise data integration, or data platform development, with substantial hands-on delivery experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAS programming, including Base SAS, DATA Step, PROC SQL, SAS Macro, and SAS Data Integration Studio or comparable SAS ETL technologies.
* Demonstrated experience developing, analyzing, debugging, and optimizing complex SAS programs and data integration workflows.
* Strong SQL expertise, including complex joins, subqueries, analytical functions, stored procedures, query optimization, and database performance tuning.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC, including Cloud Data Integration, mappings, transformations, mapping tasks, taskflows, parameterization, and workflow orchestration.
* Proven experience migrating SAS DI jobs or SAS-based ETL workflows to Informatica IDMC or equivalent Informatica cloud integration technologies.
* Strong understanding of SAS-to-Informatica migration, transformation equivalence, data type conversions, null handling, sorting, aggregation, and reconciliation.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, SQL processing, data loading, data modeling, stored procedures, pushdown processing, and performance optimization.
* Experience designing and implementing end-to-end ETL/ELT solutions across legacy and modern data platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and Git, including source control, branching, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
* Experience establishing reusable frameworks, coding standards, automated testing, release controls, and production support practices.
* Ability to investigate complex technical issues across SAS, IDMC, Snowflake, SQL, and integration workflows.
* Experience producing architecture designs, technical specifications, data flow diagrams, migration strategies, and implementation standards.
* Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, metadata, security, access control, and enterprise data governance.
* Proven ability to perform code and design reviews, guide developers, and make implementation-level technical decisions.

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. * Track delivery and operational metrics to improve predictability and quality.

**Required Experience & Capabilities**

* Proven experience managing engineering teams in complex, data-centric environments.
* Strong understanding of data platforms, releases, and change governance.
* Demonstrated ability to balance technical depth, people leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Experience applying automation and AI-assisted practices in engineering or operations is a strong advantage.

**What We Value**

* 14–15 years of overall software engineering experience with significant time in .NET/C# ecosystems.
* 5+ years leading engineers (direct people leadership), owning delivery and engineering standards.
* Proven ability to work effectively in large, distributed, international organizations and across levels.

**Technical Experience**

* NET / C# Core Expertise

Strong C# fundamentals and deep experience with Microsoft .NET Framework, including emphasis on:
  
  

* WPF, WCF, WWF
* Strong understanding of async programming, concurrency, and performance considerations

**Modern Services & Cloud-native**
Strong experience with Web API, .NET Core, and modern architecture patterns:
  
  

* Microservices
* Docker / container-based applications

**Azure DevOps Pipelines**

* Hands-on experience designing and operating Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including quality gates and release orchestration.

**Code Reviews & Engineering Standards**

* Demonstrated ability to drive high-quality, efficient code reviews, enforce standards, and mentor engineers.

**Code Optimization / Performance Engineering**

* Proven track record in profiling and code optimization strategies

**Multi-threaded / Performance-intensive Systems**

* Experience building and operating multi-threaded, performance intensive applications, with strong understanding of concurrency patterns and pitfalls.

**Source Control & Continuous Build**

* Strong experience with Git/TFS, branching, PR workflows, and continuous builds integrated into CI/CD.

* test prioritization and regression optimization
* anomaly detection in logs/telemetry
* root-cause analysis acceleration during incidents
* knowledge search across engineering artifacts (runbooks, RCA history, design notes)

**Company Description**
TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited is the India arm of NEXTY Electronics, a 100% subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho, a major general trading company in Japan. Established in April 2000 in India, the company specializes in local distribution of electrical components and delivers stable production support through a robust supply chain. Building on decades of expertise in electronics, NEXTY Electronics provides comprehensive one-stop solutions, including system solutions, bespoke software development, and connected solutions for logistics and fleet management. The company collaborates with partner EMS providers for production services and is committed to quality service and innovative, customer-focused solutions.

**Role Description**
A Senior Embedded Software Manager –PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it’s related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards.
* Algorithm & Control Design: Oversee implementation of Field-Oriented Control (FOC), maximum torque per ampere (MTPA), field-weakening, sensorless/sensored commutation, and advanced observers.
* Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls.
* People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e.g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines.
* Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

title: Customer Success Technical Architect
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA), you will be a trusted technical advisor to Confluent (an IBM Company) customers after they adopt our platform. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.
  
  
You will work as part of the broader customer account team and partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering. The role combines technical depth, customer leadership, structured execution, and the ability to translate complex architecture and operational topics into clear business outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own customer-facing technical execution for a portfolio of strategic customers, aligning activity to customer goals, adoption plans, and desired business outcomes.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from practitioners and architects to senior leaders.
* Provide proactive guidance on Confluent and Apache Kafka architecture, workload optimization, operational practices, upgrades, reliability, security, governance, and adoption.
* Maintain a regular customer operating rhythm via office hours, quarterly reviews, health checks, roadmap alignment, and enablement.
* Assess technical health, identify adoption blockers and emerging risks, and create clear action plans with owners, milestones, and follow-through.
* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or comparable practical background.
* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Success Architect, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or equivalent.
* Ability to discuss application architecture, APIs, networking, security, observability, data integration, and production operations with technical stakeholders.
* Hands on knowledge of one or more key cloud vendors (AWS, GCP and Azure)
* Solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g. VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos, etc.)
* Experience prototyping and analyzing code for client solutions in multiple languages (e.g. Java, Python, Go, etc.)
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with operating Linux, you know how to configure, tune and troubleshoot both RedHat & Debian based distributions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead structured conversations with both technical teams and executives.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and drive actions to completion.
* A proactive, consultative mindset focused on preventing issues and creating customer value rather than only reacting to incidents.
* Willingness to continue learning in a rapidly evolving technical domain and to share knowledge with peers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience helping customers build distributed systems or streaming solutions that use Apache Kafka alongside technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc
* Experience with Apache Kafka & Apache Flink
* Confluent or Apache Kafka certification
* Experience working with global customers

title: .NET Solution Architect
description:
**About The Role**
You will make the decisions that are expensive to reverse: service boundaries, data model, tenancy, how the thing degrades when a dependency is down. We build on .NET and Azure for clients who need the system to still make sense in year three, so the reasoning behind a decision matters as much as the decision.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own the architecture of .NET platforms on Azure, from discovery through to production
* Write the decision records — what was chosen, what was rejected, and what would change the answer
* Design for multi-tenancy, auditability and data residency where the client’s regulator requires it
* Set the standard for testing, observability and release safety, then hold the team to it
* Work directly with client architects and CTOs as the technical counterpart in the room
* Mentor engineers: the goal is a team that no longer needs you on every call

What we’re looking for
  
  

* Eight or more years in .NET, several of them designing systems rather than only building them
* Deep Azure — App Service, AKS, Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus and the cost model behind them
* Fluent in distributed-systems failure: retries, idempotency, eventual consistency and their costs
* Able to say no to an architecture that is more interesting than the problem requires

Nice to have
  
  
Not required. Apply if the section above fits.
  
  

* Regulated-domain experience — lending, payments or healthcare
* Event-driven or CQRS systems in production
* Azure certification

How to apply
  
  
Send your CV to hr@itlabz.in with “.NET Solution Architect” in the subject line, or WhatsApp it to +91 95605 15123. Either reaches the same team, and we reply to every application.
  
  
Email your CV Send on WhatsApp

title: IoT Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**IoT Engineer**
with 2–5 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, integrating, and deploying end-to-end IoT solutions.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across
**IoT devices, sensors, embedded systems, communication protocols, APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and backend systems**
to build reliable IoT solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design, develop, integrate, and deploy end-to-end IoT solutions.

• Work with IoT devices, sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and edge devices.

• Develop solutions using ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Implement communication using MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Modbus, and other IoT protocols.

• Develop reliable device-to-cloud communication and data transmission.

• Integrate IoT devices with REST APIs, backend services, databases, and cloud platforms.

• Work with AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud, or equivalent platforms.

• Develop and maintain IoT data pipelines for collecting, processing, and storing device data.

• Develop or integrate IoT monitoring dashboards for device status, sensor data, alerts, and performance.

• Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, connectivity, network, API, and data-related issues.

• Perform testing, debugging, validation, and deployment of IoT devices and applications.

• Monitor deployed devices and identify connectivity, performance, and data accuracy issues.

• Implement device authentication, secure communication, and basic IoT security practices.

• Work with Linux-based systems and edge computing environments.

• Maintain technical documentation related to IoT architecture, devices, APIs, configurations, and deployments.

• Collaborate with backend, software, AI/ML, and operations teams.

• Evaluate new IoT technologies and recommend suitable hardware, protocols, and platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 2–5 years of professional experience in IoT development or integration.

• Strong understanding of IoT architecture and device-to-cloud communication.

• Hands-on experience with ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Strong knowledge of MQTT and REST APIs.

• Good understanding of TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and HTTP/HTTPS.

• Programming experience in Python, C/C++, or Embedded C.

• Hands-on experience with sensors, actuators, GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, and serial communication.

• Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent databases.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or another cloud platform.

• Good understanding of Linux and command-line tools.

• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

• AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub experience.

• Experience with LoRaWAN, Zigbee, NB-IoT, 4G/5G, or cellular IoT.

• Experience with Node-RED, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

• Experience with edge computing and Raspberry Pi/Linux-based gateways.

• Knowledge of Docker and containerized deployments.

• Understanding of IoT security, authentication, encryption, and secure communication.

• Experience with OTA firmware updates and device management.

• Exposure to Edge AI / AI at the Edge.

• Experience in industrial IoT, logistics, asset tracking, fleet monitoring, or supply-chain applications.

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, IoT, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on IoT project experience will be considered an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be able to independently understand and implement the complete IoT flow:

**Sensor/Device → Embedded System → Connectivity → MQTT/API → Edge/Cloud → Backend → Database → Dashboard/Alerts**

The candidate should be comfortable working across
**hardware, firmware, networking, cloud, and software integration**
, rather than focusing on only one component.

**Key Skills**

IoT | MQTT | ESP32 | Raspberry Pi | Arduino | Python | C/C++ | Embedded Systems | Sensors | REST APIs | AWS | Azure | GCP | TCP/IP | Wi-Fi | BLE | Modbus | Linux | Cloud | Databases | Edge Computing

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
The Staff Software Development Engineer role within Clearwater’s Agentic Client Interactions & Orchestration (ACIO) is a senior technical leadership position focused on architecting, designing, and delivering large-scale distributed systems that power critical financial reporting and analytics. This role requires deep expertise in scalable system design, agentic architecture, cloud-native platforms, and high-performance data processing.
  
  
You will play a key role in shaping the technical direction, ensuring architectural excellence, and enabling teams to build robust, maintainable systems that support Clearwater’s commitment to industry-leading financial reporting solutions. Senior engineers at this level are expected to think strategically, lead through influence, and drive innovations that scale across products and teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of Clearwater ACIO systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in large-scale financial data processing.
* Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems.
* Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
* Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps.
* Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery**

* Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater.
* Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation.
* Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks.
* Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development.
* Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies.
* Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency.
* Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven architecture and design expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably in financial or analytics platforms.
* Exceptional leadership skills and ability to lead through influence as a technical architect or senior tech lead.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and data streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including scaling, cost optimization, and multi-region deployments.
* Proficiency in one or more modern languages (Java, Python, Go, or similar) with deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of distributed data storage, database scaling, and query optimization techniques.
* Worked on agentic conversational UX design and architecture.
* Developed and deployed systems with complex SLAs in production environments serving high-volume traffic/data.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly convey architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commitment to continuous technical learning, improvement, and community knowledge sharing.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience; 5+ years acting in an architecture or principal engineering capacity.
* Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-grade distributed systems and owning them through full lifecycle (design → build → deploy → maintain).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302348
description:

We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. – Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.

Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. title: Director - Application Development
description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**I. The Mission**
You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a
**technical visionary**
who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an
**AI-first development culture (AIDLC)**
to set a new industry standard for productivity.
  
  
As the
**Director of Application Development**
, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the
**Fintech and Banking**
sectors.
  
  
You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios.
  
  
The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products.
  
  
The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships.
  
  
**II. The Core Mandate**

* Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies.
* Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features.
* Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability.
* Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
* Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards.
* AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience.
* Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security.
* Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions.
* Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement.
* Organizational Mentorship
* Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors.
* Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity.
* Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy.

**III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)**

* Academic Excellence: B.Tech / B.E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA).

**IV. Experience & Skills**

* Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership.
* Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance).
* Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously.
* Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration.
* Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers.

**High-Weightage Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e.g., LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing).
* Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures.
* A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools.
* System Reliability: Maintaining 99.99% uptime for critical banking portfolios.
* Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline.

**V. Why This Role?**
This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
As a Sr. Software Engineer I on our engineering team, you will design, develop, and deliver high-performing full-stack applications with a major focus on advanced React front-end architecture and AI/ML solution integration. In this role, you will spearhead the creation of rich, responsive, component-driven user interfaces using React while building robust backend microservices in Java and optimizing relational database applications with PL/SQL. Additionally, you will play a key role in architecting and deploying AI/ML capabilities, predictive models, and intelligent workflows into enterprise healthcare software to drive data-driven decision-making and automated user experiences.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Architect, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance web interfaces using React.js, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and component-driven front-end design patterns
* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML-powered solutions and intelligent capabilities to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Integrate AI/ML models, machine learning APIs, and generative AI features into full-stack Java and React applications to power automated workflows
* Use enterprise-approved AI tools and ML platforms to streamline software development workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement
* Evaluate emerging trends in AI/ML engineering and modern React front-end frameworks to inform architecture design and strategic innovation
* Write, optimize, and maintain high-performance database queries, stored procedures, and triggers using PL/SQL to support AI/ML data models and web applications
* Build and maintain robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java to seamlessly connect React front-ends with AI/ML services and relational database layers
* Conduct code reviews, implement unit/integration testing, and enforce software engineering and AI/ML safety and quality standards
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience working in a full-stack capacity
* 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and building modern front-end user interfaces using React.js (including state management, Hooks, and component architecture)
* 4+ years of backend software engineering experience using Java and enterprise frameworks (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot)
* 4+ years of experience working with relational databases and writing complex PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and database optimizations
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices to support React web applications and AI/ML integrations
* 3+ years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum development team
* 3+ years of experience integrating AI/ML models, machine learning APIs, or intelligent automation services into software applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML frameworks, model deployment platforms, Large Language Models (LLMs), or MLOps practices
* Experience with advanced React state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API) and modern web build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite)
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in the healthcare technology domain or working with health data standards
* Familiarity with CI/CD deployment pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Technical Lead/Project Lead/ Engineering Manager- Java
description:
Bold is seeking for senior professional who is having experience in building scalable, high-performance applications. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, hands-on experience with GraphQL, and strong knowledge of AWS cloud-native services. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise solutions, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC)tools like Terraform and CloudFormation to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable deployments.

BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.
  
  
Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.

* Collaborate with product managers, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes

* Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot.
* Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures using SQS, SNS, and Kinesis.
* Proficiency in GraphQL API development.
* Strong background in AWS services (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Auto Scaling, API Gateway, etc.).
* Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed system design.
* Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills.

**EXPERIENCE-**

* Technical Lead/ Project Lead/ Engineering Manager- Java- 9 years+

**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**

* Competitive salary
* Tax-friendly compensation structure
* Bi-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company

* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, & term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage

* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)

**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**

* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick-up and drop-off facility

**About BOLD**

We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. title: Software Engineering Director
description:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver be
  
  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
Job Duties:
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and quick-to-learn Software Engineer to join the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) field, specifically to advance the Questa formal verification product family. In this multifaceted role, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from writing functional specifications to designing algorithms, coding, and creating test plans. Collaboration with a team of talented engineers and supporting top-tier industry customers will be essential.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive software development experience, particularly in developing and customizing components around graph-based formal models, with hands-on programming and expertise in crafting efficient netlist representation models for formal applications.
  
  
Our primary responsibilities will include crafting and developing new features, customizing existing solutions, and improving software components for formal verification, ensuring quality, scalability, modifiability, and testability. You will collaborate with other engineering teams, take ownership of specific components, and drive them to excellence. Additionally, you will help drive the best software practices within the team and mentor other specialists as needed, all while contributing to the business’s overall needs.
  
  
Job Qualifications:
  
  

* We require candidates to have a BE/B-Tech/M.Tech in CSE/ECE from a reputed engineering college.
* We are looking for candidates with 25 years of software experience, preferably in the Design and Verification domain.
* Expert in C++, design patterns, and algorithms.
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithm complexities.
* Proficient in advanced data structures and their applications.
* Expert in one of the following hardware description languages: Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL.
* Knowledge of scripting languages like Perl, Python, Bash, or Tcl.
* Proficient with development tools such as Makefile, gdb, valgrind, perforce/git, gcov, editors, and IDEs.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Experienced in the development and delivery of multi-man-month projects from start to finish.
* Familiarity with Linux platforms.
* Exposure to formal-based verification methodologies (model checking, equivalence checking, automated reasoning) is a plus.

Soft Skills:
  
  

* Self-motivated and committed to work.
* Strong team player with the ability to work independently.
* Hardworking, sincere, and open to constructive feedback.
* Able to work in challenging environments and collaborate effectively with multi-cultural technical teams.

Good to Have:
  
  

* Exposure to Synthesis, Simulation, and other verification methodologies like Assertion, Coverage, etc.
* Strong presentation, listening, and communication skills for effective team interactions.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**SAP BTP Architect**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a SAP BTP Architect with 10 to 15 years of relevant experience to join our dynamic team. This role designing and governing scalable, secure, and cloud‑native solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). The role focuses on application architecture using CAPM and/or RAP, side‑by‑side extensibility, and embedding SAP Business AI capabilities while ensuring Clean Core compliance across SAP landscapes.
  
  

* Define end‑to‑end solution architecture on SAP BTP
* Design application extensions using:

+ CAPM (Node.js/Java) and/or
+ RAP (ABAP Cloud, CDS, OData V4)

* Define extensibility strategy aligned with Clean Core principles
* Architect cloud‑native, multi‑tenant, and scalable applications
* Integrate applications with S/4HANA (Public & Private Cloud) and non‑SAP systems
* Design and embed SAP Business AI scenarios, including:

+ SAP AI Business Services (e.g., Document Information Extraction, DAR)
+ Generative AI via AI Core / Generative AI Hub

* Ensure enterprise‑grade security, governance, and compliance
* Review designs, perform architectural governance, and guide delivery teams
* Drive POCs, innovation initiatives, and reuse frameworks
* Mentor developers, leads, and managers on BTP architecture and best practices
* Support pre‑sales, estimations, and technical solutioning where required

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in SAP BTP architecture e.g. Event driven, Micro service based

**Hands‑on experience with:**

* BTP Accounts & cloud principles
* CAPM (CDS, services, events, multitenancy)
* RAP / Advance ABAP for cloud, Design Patterns & OOPS
* Runtime environment ( Cloud foundry, kyma and ABAP )
* OData V4
* SAP Fiori Elements / UI5

**Deep understanding of:**

* Clean Core & Side‑by‑Side extensibility
* S/4HANA Cloud extensibility models

**Experience with SAP Business AI, including:**

* AI Business Services
* AI Core & AI Launchpad
* Generative AI integration patterns
* Strong stakeholder, leadership, and communication skills

**Preferred Skills:**

* SAP Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Build Process Automation
* DevOps, CI/CD, and Transport Management on BTP

**SAP Certifications:**

* SAP BTP
* CAPM / ABAP Cloud / RAP
* SAP Business AI

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
